main_text.p: re, iniufte patrata in Ignatium amplecti. ni dicant, illi Synodo vnum fuiffe omnia, & vim, & æquitatem fimul cum iniuftitia, & fcelere collocaffe; quod ftultum eft affere-re. Sed hæc alibi fufius.

At id præceperat Ioannes. Si verba Ioannis confiderentur in Epiftolis, longe hoc falfiffimum effe deprehenderetur. Nunquam Ioannes infontem, & a culpa immunem declarauit, imo uti nefarijs flagitijs contaminatiffimum, iuffit in plena Synodo, crimina confitendo misericordiam exorare, tum ob delicta poenitentia peracta in fedem collocari. Hi vero Synodi cognitores, & iudices terminos facultatis fibi conceffæ prætergredientes, nullum ab ipfo libellum confeffionis exigunt, nullam poenitentiam imponunt, & nullo præuio examine, tumultuofe iufte acta in Synodis condemnant, iniufte peracta in Ignatium deofculantnr. An non eft hoc insanire acerbiffime? Vbi leges? Vbi iudicia? & monftra, & prodigia aliun, de quæris? Zacharias Metropolita Chalcedonensis ibidem;
Οὐκ ἐν αὐτῷ [?] ὁ μόνῳ, οὐδὲ ἐν πᾶσι [?] χώρᾳ λαοῦ [?] ἡ [?] βασιλείᾳ [illegible, ~12 letters] ἀλλὰ μικρᾷ [?] παῖς ἐπήλθε τοῖς λόγοις τοῦ γλῶ [?] τῆς πλάνης [illegible, ~10 letters].
Καὶ μάρτυς ἡ Ἀφρικῶν [?] χώρα, ἡ ἐν Μεσοποταμίᾳ, καὶ ἔθνη ὁλόκληρα βαρβαρικά, καὶ ὠμὸν τὴν ζωὴν διαζῶντα βίον.

page.notes: Greek lines 2 and 3 of the final paragraph are faint and partly illegible; the marked words are best readings. Printed "deofculantnr" and "aliun," are kept as printed, possibly a printing error. The running head is absent. The page number 146 is printed at the head.
